orientation.description: Canvas orientation. This template is horizontal-only (16:9, 1920×1080) — screen recordings are landscape.

width.description: Explicit canvas width; overrides the orientation default

height.description: Explicit canvas height; overrides the orientation default

audio.description: Single full-script narration path relative to videos/<slug>/

screencast.description: REQUIRED. Path (relative to videos/<slug>/) to the transcoded screen-recording MP4 that plays as a root-level video under the entire video — every scene composites transparently on top of it.

capHighlight.description: Karaoke highlight color (hex) for the caption word currently being spoken. Default #FFD24A (gold).

id.description: Unique kebab-case id → filename and composition-id

type.description: Frame type selector. A screen recording plays underneath every scene, for the whole video — every type here is a TRANSPARENT overlay, never a full-bleed image or diagram. No type generates or references any picture.

typeUsage.screencast: DEFAULT for almost every scene. Bottom scrim, an optional short step-title badge, and the karaoke caption line, all over the live recording. Use this unless the scene is the very first or very last in the video.
typeUsage.title-card: ONLY the opening scene. Large centered headline over the recording (which keeps playing, dimmed, behind it), then fades out to hand off to the plain screencast overlay.
typeUsage.outro: ONLY the closing scene. Heavier centered scrim with a closing headline + subheadline, held to the end of the video.

start.description: Scene start in seconds (system-computed from alignment).

fg.description: Foreground/text color (hex). Optional — defaults are tuned for legibility over a live recording.

eyebrow.description: Small mono badge above the headline, ≤24 chars. (title-card, outro)

headline.description: Main display text, ≤44 chars; wrap key words in **double asterisks** for accent highlight. REQUIRED for title-card and outro.

subheadline.description: Secondary line under the headline, ≤60 chars. REQUIRED for outro, optional for title-card.

stepTitle.description: Short imperative action label for the step currently playing, 2-5 words, e.g. 'Open Settings'. Optional — omit on scenes that are a transition or aside rather than a distinct step; a badge on every scene is noise over the recording. (screencast)

captions.description: Naturally-split caption chunks displayed sequentially during the scene, 2-6 words and ≤55 chars each. Doubles as the scene's expected narration text (chunks joined with spaces). System-supplied, not authored.

captionTiming.description: Populate/align-computed, not hand-authored: one {text,start,end,words} per captions[] chunk in scene-local seconds. words[] holds one {text,start,end} per whitespace token for the karaoke spoken-word highlight.
